scope: backend check-url policy selection and deterministic evaluation; no appeal reuse or lease recovery decision

cases.description: School activates at its exact start minute.
At exact school end, active home policy takes over.
Home applies before school starts.
Active school wins even when home would block another category.
Empty school category selection still suppresses overlapping home and skips fallback.
Disabled school allows home to become effective.
Inclusive school holiday does not disable home coverage.
The last excluded school date is included.
A gap between all configured windows has no managed policy.
Weekday school windows do not run on Sunday.
An unenrolled snapshot has no policy.
all_day uses the selected weekday and ignores nominal clock bounds.
Overnight start is inclusive on selected start day.
Overnight tail applies on the following weekday.
Overnight end is exclusive.
An excluded start-day suppresses an overnight tail.
An excluded current-day suppresses an overnight tail.
01:45 local before the spring DST transition.
03:00 local after nonexistent 02:xx remains inside the window.
03:30 local ends the window after DST jump.
First 01:45 local during autumn repeated hour.
Second 01:45 local also remains active.
02:00 local after repeated hour ends the window.
01:45 local precedes the spring gap.
Spring jump to 03:00 is outside a 01:30–02:30 window.
An exact authorized path allows even classified blocked content.
Path descendants inherit the exception.
A path string prefix without slash boundary is not exempt.
Encoded reserved slash cannot create an allowlist path boundary.
Unreserved percent escapes share canonical path identity.
Dot segment navigation cannot retain an exempt apparent prefix.
Dot-delimited subdomain matching requires explicit opt-in.
Exact-host exception does not include subdomains.
An attacker host containing an allowed suffix without dot is not exempt.
Allowed host text before an attacker suffix is not exempt.
Host exceptions cover both default HTTP and HTTPS ports.
Default-port exceptions do not authorize nonstandard ports.
The same explicit nonstandard port remains scoped.
An exception expires at its exact timestamp.
An exception remains valid strictly before expiry.
International host names match their canonical ASCII host.
IPv6 exception matches the exact address.
No category evidence uses configured unknown fallback.
Unknown fallback may explicitly allow.
Selecting Unknown blocks unknown outcomes even when fallback allows.
Unavailable classification follows unavailable fallback.
An unavailable source may explicitly fall back to allow.
Selecting Not-Resolved covers unavailable resolution outcomes.
Unsupported coverage uses fallback without manufacturing Not-Resolved evidence.
Known selected evidence blocks despite another unavailable source and allow fallback.
Known evidence remains decisive before unknown fallback.
Matched categories preserve evidence order, deduplicate, then append outcome status.
Classified categories absent from selected set are allowed.
Any unexpected status is treated as unavailable, never an implicit allow.
Only one trailing slash is removed from an allowlist entry; multiple slashes remain distinct path boundaries.
